blocks.text:
Day 2 · Breakfast, then a 4-hour tour: the cable car to Morro da Urca, with its wide observation deck, and on to Sugar Loaf, with views of Copacabana, the bay, the islands, the bridge to Niterói and Christ the Redeemer, then old Rio, with its historic churches, monasteries, Metropolitan Cathedral and colonial buildings. Rest in the afternoon before the big night.

Evening · The Parade of Champions at the Sambadrome: the winning samba schools of Carnival 2027 parade once more, with their spectacular costumes and floats, in a joyful, festive night of music and dance. Transfer back to the hotel after the parade.
Pictured: the cable car to Sugar Loaf

blocks.text:
After breakfast, take a 4-hour tour of Corcovado to the statue of Christ.

From the station, an ecological train climbs through the jungle to the summit. The Tijuca Forest can be seen on both sides of the railway.

The 38 m statue of Christ the Redeemer, erected in 1931, stands at an elevation of 710 m. From the observation deck, you can see Rio and its surroundings: the bridge to Niterói, Guanabara Bay, the Botanical Garden, Maracanã Stadium and Sugar Loaf.

In your free time, we recommend watching the sunset from the rocks of Arpoador: sit by the ocean and watch the sun sink below the horizon.

In the evening, you can try seafood at Marius restaurant. This visit costs an additional $130 per person.
